descByPlatform.chatgpt: Cinematic Collage Poster for SILVER LIGHT FILM FESTIVAL Vol. 12 Brooklyn Academy. Subject: six vertical film stills arranged in a 3×2 grid occupying 12-88% x 14-70% y, each still tinted warm amber #D4B775 with split-tone cool teal #2E4A55 shadow, 35mm grain scatter, gate-weave frame edge; subject matter — lovers silhouette, rain-soaked street, dancer mid-leap, desert road, a child's face, empty theatre. Composition: Rule of Thirds grid seams, Centered 50% x hero vertical, thin 4pt teal divider rules, AR 2:3. Camera: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP, Schneider 80mm LS at f/11, 1/125s, ISO 100, copy-stand flat-field. Lighting: Softbox Studio Top Lighting — 4×6ft softbox overhead 2m (key flat-field), 4×4ft white bounce below 0.6m (fill), 4×4ft black flag camera-left for edge falloff. Material physics: halide silver grain, gate-weave scratch, emulsion scuff. Typography: 'SILVER LIGHT FILM FESTIVAL · VOL. 12' 52pt Didot cream #F4ECD8 centred 50% x 22% y; subhead 'MAY 3-11 · BROOKLYN ACADEMY · 84 FILMS' 14pt Inter tracking-250 #F4ECD8 centred 50% x 86% y. Color grade: DaVinci Teal-Amber-Split LUT grain 12 -0.1 EV. Palette: amber #D4B775 36%, teal #2E4A55 26%, cream #F4ECD8 12%, black #1A1A1A 18%, mid-grey 8%. References: Criterion Collection, Saul Bass credits, Akiko Stehrenberger. Exclude: CGI gloss, clean vector, modern sans headline, colour cast, pristine edges.
